description: Department of Local Government - Northern Province - The election of New Chairman for the Mannar Pradeshiya Sabha in Norther Province
reasoning: This gazette notice announces the convening of a meeting for the election to fill the vacant position of Chairman of Mannar Pradeshiya Sabha.
